name: Tarlov Cyst / Perineural Cyst
definition: CSF-filled perineural cyst most commonly arising around sacral nerve roots; many are incidental while a minority may correlate with radicular, pelvic or sphincter symptoms.

typical: Possible sphincter symptoms in selected cases

investigations.principle: MRI sacrum/lumbosacral spine identifies cyst anatomy; clinical correlation is essential.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Interventional or surgical treatment is reserved for carefully selected symptomatic cases.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Sacral/Vata-neuralgic phenotype may be documented only as a parallel assessment.

patientEducation.summary: CSF-filled perineural cyst most commonly arising around sacral nerve roots; many are incidental while a minority may correlate with radicular, pelvic or sphincter symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
